about: The promotion gate's rules (chapter 23), as data. python -m helpdesk.gate check tests them on every change: with this many trials, a regression case must be able to fail the gate, and one still passing at the expected rate must rarely fail it by chance. expected_pass_rate and false_alarm are the lab's choices; change them here, never in the code. every_trial names suites where one failed trial fails the gate. paired_min_cases is the fewest cases the paired 95% interval is used on, since it rests on the normal approximation. require_real true means only a run on a real model may promote; the lab leaves it false because no paid run has been made.
